ruled-narrow.reason: Only line spacing changes; use the ruled spacing parameter.

ruled-wide.reason: Only line spacing changes; use the ruled spacing parameter.

grid-fine.reason: Only square pitch changes; use the grid spacing parameter.

grid-large.reason: Only square pitch changes; use the grid spacing parameter.

dot-fine.reason: Only dot pitch changes; use the dot spacing parameter.

cornell-mirrored.reason: The cue column is mirrored; writing behavior and partition topology are unchanged.

fishbone-four.reason: Cause-branch count changes; it is a parameter of the fishbone topology.

storyboard-three.reason: Panel count alone is a variant of equal sequential frames with caption bands.

storyboard-four.reason: Panel count alone is a variant of equal sequential frames with caption bands.

isometric-grid.reason: Both use the same three-axis equilateral lattice; the intended use differs, not the geometry.

engineering-grid.reason: A uniform grid with emphasized major lines is a line-weight variant; the overview/detail topology is separately represented by grid-hierarchical.

two-right-narrow.reason: The narrow column is mirrored; use the same partition with a side parameter.

three-stacked-cards.reason: Only the count of equal vertical cards changes.

six-cards.reason: Only the count of equal cards in a regular grid changes.

eight-cards.reason: Only the count of equal cards in a regular grid changes.

mirrored-compare-cards.reason: Equal comparison cards with mirrored content positions are a count and orientation variant.

cross-compare.reason: An unlabeled cross makes the same four open regions as quadrant; comparison is a use case.

matrix-3x2.reason: Transposing the same equal-cell matrix is an orientation variant.

matrix-3x3.reason: Nine equal contiguous cells are the same geometry; general classification is an additional use case.

axis-matrix.reason: Central axes with tick references already have a canonical geometry.

weighted-matrix.reason: Changing row or column proportions without new partitions is a size variant.

flower-six.reason: The petal count changes, but the center-and-single-ring bubble topology is unchanged.

flow-five-vertical.reason: A linear flow rotated and given one extra equal step is an orientation/count variant.

cycle-six.reason: Cycle node count changes, but the ring-flow topology is unchanged.

causal-chain.reason: A linear cause chain uses the same directed sequence geometry; causal interpretation belongs in the guide.

problem-solution-three.reason: One-to-three or three-to-one branching reverses arrow direction without changing the star topology.

five-why-chain.reason: Same five vertical writing boxes; the five-whys guide supplies causal questioning rather than chronological steps.

root-cause-tree.reason: Reversing a branching tree from decisions to causes changes interpretation, not its branching geometry.

mindmap-eight.reason: Two extra equal spokes are a node-count parameter on the same radial concept topology.

bottom-up-tree.reason: Reading the same hierarchy upward is an orientation and interpretation variant.

pyramid-five.reason: Extra horizontal tiers change count, not the triangular layered topology.

frayer.reason: The classic four-area concept study fits the existing four quadrants around a central concept; labels are supplied by the guide, not printed.

cue-answer.reason: A narrow cue column and wide answer column use the existing unequal two-column partition.

recall-strip.reason: The existing cue/notes/summary partition supports a separate retrieval strip as a method variant.

concept-examples-six.reason: Six examples around a central concept share the radial six-spoke topology.

quote-side-notes.reason: A slim annotation margin beside a main quotation area uses the same two-column geometry.

quote-comment-parallel.reason: Quotation and commentary are two equal parallel writing columns.

observation-interpretation.reason: Observation and interpretation are two parallel writing columns; the difference is instructional.

source-large-plus-cards.reason: One dominant source region with three subsidiary cards shares the existing hero-card composition.

research-index-cards.reason: Four equal source cards reuse the canonical card-grid geometry.

crazy-eight.reason: Eight equal sketch cells are a grid-count variant; use the card-grid topology with eight panels.

idea-bubbles-six.reason: Six bubbles around a center are a node-count variant of a single-ring idea flower.

hero-idea-seven-variations.reason: The central idea and outer variations share the center-surrounding-boxes topology; seven versus eight is a count variant.

dual-input-synthesis.reason: Two inputs rather than three converge on one output; the merge topology is unchanged.

seven-ideation-cards.reason: Seven equal cards are a count variant of the regular card grid.

two-sketch-notes.reason: Two equal captioned sketch panels differ from the canonical storyboard by panel count only.

mixed-storyboard.reason: Changing the number of large and small panels preserves the mixed-scale storyboard composition.

pixel-stitch-grid.reason: Regular square cells for pixels or stitches are a use case of the standard grid; count and pitch are variants.

ruled-and-sketch.reason: Reversing the ruled and sketch zones is an orientation variant of the same two-zone page.
